summary: Frontend re-verification of identity-bridge UI (reconcile roles + per-staff invite/creds dialog) inside the reachable HRTab for gym tenants. All flows PASS as owner@isodemo.com.
critical_code_review_comments: HRTab.js is ~1160 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting CredsDialog, ProfilePanel, and hooks into separate modules for maintainability.
issueCredentials uses window.confirm chains (2 sequential confirms) — works but suboptimal UX; consider migrating to a shadcn dialog with radio choice link/temp-password.
reconcileRoles alert uses window.alert — could use toast for consistency with the rest of the app.
seed_data_creation: None — used seeded staff Alex Rivera (portal.staff@pulsedemo.test)
verified_flows: Operations → Staffing tab → People group → HR sub-tab reachable (URL stays /dashboard, tabs render correctly)
data-testid=staff-reconcile-roles-btn visible in HR header ('Fix login roles' button)
Click → confirm() dialog shown → POST /api/staffing/reconcile-roles returned 200 with body {ok:true, checked:9, updated:0, changes:[]} → alert 'Done — 0 of 9 logins updated to match their job role.'
Selecting a staff member (Alex Rivera) opened ProfilePanel showing 'Invite to platform' button (data-testid=staff-issue-creds-btn)

Click → confirm() 'Invite Alex Rivera as Fitness Instructor?' → second confirm() 'Send set-password link vs temp password' → POST /api/staffing/staff/{id}/issue-credentials returned 200 with keys [ok, email, role, delivery, temp_password, invite_url, created, email_sent]

Credentials dialog (data-testid=staff-creds-dialog) rendered without crash; email portal.staff@pulsedemo.test and role 'Staff' shown; staff-creds-invite-url present (temp_password not rendered because user chose link path — expected)
Copy buttons (staff-creds-email-copy) exist; 'Done' button (staff-creds-done) dismisses dialog (dialog count 0 after click); close button (staff-creds-close) present
notes_for_next_agent: HR identity-bridge UI is fully reachable and functional for gym tenant owner@isodemo.com. The reconcile call returned updated=0 because seeded logins already match — this is expected on repeat runs. temp_password field is only rendered when user picks that path in the second confirm; link path (OK) renders invite_url instead — verified correct branching in CredsDialog.
